title: Let the passing-witness transition stand before preferred promotion
failure_signature: The first x1 builder run recorded a passing witness that automatically promoted its method to validated, then attempted the invalid transition from validated to validated.
trigger_preconditions: canonical runner auto-promotes on passing witness
builder requests an explicit state transition
candidate_workaround: Treat a passing witness as the validated transition and request only the next legal state.
recurrence_guard: Re-read method state after every witness command before issuing an explicit transition.
rollback: Stop the builder, preserve the partial ledger, and resume without deleting or duplicating evidence.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
